Beach days, off the clock

The About photos start personal: a sunset selfie on the beach, where Raf kitesurfs whenever the wind — and family life — allows.

I'm Raf, a software engineer based in Ghent, Belgium. I've built interfaces across esports, fashion, skincare, sports, entertainment and web3 — ten years in, the field doesn't really matter; I just want to build the best possible experiences for people.

Outside work, most of my time belongs to my family: my girlfriend and the sweetest four-year-old ever. When there's time left, I kitesurf at the beach or tinker with my homelab — it could always use another container, right?

Find me on Twitter, GitHub and LinkedIn, or email me at raf@derolez.dev ⧉

Built at Foundation Labs·iOS·Web

An onchain social network for experimental creators, built at Foundation Labs in 2024. Every post was collectable — fans could tip a creator and hold a stake in the work, with the crypto kept invisible.

It grew to over 20,000 daily active users before sunsetting in 2026. I owned every user-facing surface on both web and native, from onboarding to account deletion.

Built at Foundation Labs·iOS

A prediction game for pop-culture fanatics, built with Foundation Labs in 2025. Players trade virtual Aura on what happens next in their favourite TV shows — no wallets, no real money — across tag-based markets with a global leaderboard and spoiler protection.

For the Survivor 49 finale we onboarded an entire Brooklyn watch party live — proof that prediction markets work as entertainment layered on culture. I owned the app's design engineering throughout.

Freelance·Web

Rebuilt Timeline.com as a headless Next.js and Shopify platform — UX, performance, and brand in one sweep, contributing to a 36x increase in sales.
